title_sq: Apartament ne shitje 2+1 Astir, Vila L.
description_sq:
Apartmanet 2+1 ne shitje, Astir, Vila L. Ne nje nga zonat me te kerkuara shitet apartament 2+1, me siperfaqe totale 103.55 m2 (91.55 m2 neto), kati i 8, totalisht i mobiluar. Apartamenti organizohet nga nje koridor qe ben shperndarjen ne sallonin e ndenjes, i cili ka dhe kendin e gatimit bashke me tavolinen e ngrenies te vecuar, nje ballkon i mbyllur ne krah te sallonit. Dy dhoma gjumi, te cilat lidhen gjithashtu me njera-tjetren nepermjet ballkonit qe per momentin eshte i mbyllur dhe ka funksion te nje guzhine te vogel gatimi si dhe tualeti. Apartamenti zoteron dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor dhe shitet sic eshte i mobiluar ne foto.
Per me shume informacion ose nje vizite ne prone jeni te lutur te na kontaktoni.
title_en: Apartment for sale 2+1 Astir, Vila L.
description_en: 2+1 apartments for sale, Astir, Vila L. In one of the most sought-after areas, a 2+1 apartment is for sale, with a total area of ​​103.55 m2 (91.55 m2 net), 8th floor, fully furnished. The apartment is organized by a corridor that divides the living room, which also has a cooking corner with a separate dining table, a closed balcony next to the living room. Two bedrooms, which are also connected to each other through the balcony that is currently closed and has the function of a small kitchen and toilet. The apartment has regular mortgage documentation and is sold as furnished in the photos. For more information or a visit to the property, please contact us.
